title: LORD JIM by Joseph Conrad Easton Press Hardcover Bound In Genuine Leather
descriptionText:
This limited edition collector's hardcover book is a must-have for any book collector or literature enthusiast. Bound in genuine leather and featuring beautiful illustrations, this book is a true gem. With a focus on the topic of literature, this book is perfect for anyone interested in the subject.

The book, titled LORD JIM by Joseph Conrad, is an original and comes from the United States. It is published by Easton Press and has a publication date of Norwalk, CT. The book is not signed or personalized and is a standard edition. It is a part of the 100 Greatest Books Ever Written series and is a true collector's item.
